question: Can a bounded residual pilot beat simple physical/train-fitted references enough to justify a planning-aware selective prediction foundation?
ego_prior_reason: Use available current velocity and acceleration without future-derived yaw or fitted weights; freeze before residual results, no switching to ridge.

ridge.selection: 3-fold recording-group CV inside train only, scene-macro XY ADE

small_cache_visual_comparison.note: Only visual residual changes here; do not also add ego/spatial residuals in this control.

expanded_data.scale_note: Preserve historical cap24. Actual native recording availability takes precedence over nominal window targets; never duplicate or relax caps to force target counts.

expanded_training.execution_gate: resolved preprocessing, verified 3-way split, successful 200-window encoder profile, approved GPU free; start A only, then registered paired B/E/F if viable

decision_rules.G1: Ridge-relative ADE is a practical pilot gate, not a rejection of the research hypothesis.
decision_rules.G2: Compare spatial position errors in meters by horizon against CV; failure withholds forecast-accuracy claims, not planning utility.
decision_rules.G3: Persistence-relative visual MSE is a forecast-accuracy gate, not proof for or against planning utility.
